criterionOutcomes.criterion: When a selected Ping point’s details have loaded, the detail view shows that point’s Ping Time with the unit milliseconds (ms).
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-1-cluster.png identifies the selected mm wave 2 event at 06/10/2026 10:36:18; criterion-1-final.png shows the matching Ping detail with Ping Time 24 ms.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: When Ping attributes are returned for the selected point, the detail view displays those attributes alongside the Ping Time.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-2-ping-cluster.png and criterion-2-final.png show the selected 06/10/2026 10:36:18 event with Ping Time 24 ms alongside Jitter 2 ms, Cell ID 33097_110_4 and Data Technology 5G NSA.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: With 5G NSA as the only selected technology, opening a Ping point displays details for that selected point without an error state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-3-only-5g-nsa.png shows Ping configured with only 5G NSA, but criterion-3-ping-added.png and criterion-3-final.png show multiple existing layers and an Automobile HTTP Browsing error tab. Workspace isolation was unavailable; no selected Ping detail attributable to this configuration was established.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: While Ping details are loading, the detail view shows a loading state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Unstable restored workspace prevented an isolated Ping loading transition. criterion-4-final.png shows a Surveyor Upload cluster and Automobile tabs, with no Ping detail loading state captured.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: When Ping details are unavailable, the detail view shows a no-data state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: No reproducible selectable Ping no-data fixture was supplied or established. criterion-5-final.png shows an Automobile HTTP Browsing load error, not a Ping no-data state; workspace isolation was also unavailable.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: When Ping details fail to load, the detail view shows an error state and does not display data as if it belonged to the selected point.
criterionOutcomes.reason: No reproducible selected-Ping detail-load-failure fixture was supplied or established. criterion-6-final.png shows an Automobile HTTP Browsing error and Surveyor cluster tabs; it cannot establish Ping error handling or protection against incorrect selected-point data.

reason: Reviewed all six criteria against attempt-001. Two display assertions have direct Ping evidence; four remain blocked by workspace isolation or unavailable Ping fixtures. The unrelated Automobile error is not evidence of a Ping defect.
